claims.text: Scully's account, published in Variety in 1949 and in 'Behind the Flying Saucers' in 1950, placed the crash in March 1948 in Hart Canyon twelve miles northeast of Aztec, with a 99-foot craft and sixteen bodies.
The book described a craft 99 feet in diameter containing sixteen humanoid bodies, said to have come from Venus and to work on magnetic principles, with every dimension divisible by nine.
Scully's account placed the Aztec crash in March 1948 at Hart Canyon, twelve miles northeast of Aztec, New Mexico, with a 99-foot craft and sixteen humanoid bodies.
